serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.NoBlush
Landlord: Hyi-e-e-e-h! I-impossible! 
What was that sound?! As soon as he heard bot's response, a weird screech came out of his mouth!
D-did he somehow recognize that {f_botName} is a sexbot?!
Landlord: T-t-t-there is no way! T-t-t-t-this has to be a lie!
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
#bot.Expression.Angry
Landlord: Y-you piece of shit! How did you pull that off, huh?!
You: W-what do you mean?!
Landlord: Don’t play dumb! {{wi}}How did you entrap such a beautiful woman? Blackmail? Grooming? Or maybe she’s trying to get a green card or something?
You: Rude!
S-safe! He’s way off the mark, but also said some hurtful stuff! Why is everyone so surprised that my girlfriend is cute?! I understand that she’s a sexbot and I pretty much found her in a ditch, b-but it’s not like I’m a total loser! 
You: Come on now, I had girlfriends before, you know?
Landlord: Hmph! Like one, maybe? 
…
Landlord: No matter how many fours and fives you dated, guys like you can’t just appear with a ten out of nowhere! 
You: My ex was way better than five… 
You: Anyway, why is it so hard for you to believe I found someone good? Maybe I’m just such a great guy? Have you considered it?
#bot.Expression.NoAngry
Landlord: I refuse to believe that! I don’t know how you pulled this off, but congratulations! I guess…
Landlord: What’s your name, my lady?~
Bot: I’m {f_botName}, nice to meet you.
Landlord: Nice to meet you too~ {{wi}}What’s with this weird name though? Oh, right, this whole building is mine by the way. I also have some other properties downtown and to the east hehe~ People call me Mr Landlord around here.
This guy, acting all chummy! He has no shame…
Landlord: Anyway, why is such a cute girl, hehe~, hanging out with a guy like him?
#bot.Expression.VeryHappy
#bot.Expression.VeryBlush
Bot: B-because we love each other!-!
T-that’s kinda embarrassing when she says it in front of other people…
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
#bot.Expression.NoBlush
#bot.Expression.Angry
Landlord: Yeah, that has to be a lie. 
Landlord: It’s alright though, keep your secrets if you want.
#bot.Expression.NoAngry
Landlord: Hehe~ You are so cute that I’m not even mad that you lied to me.
Landlord: Listen Anon, if I knew that you had such a fine lass living with you, you could have avoided that 500$ increase in rent.
You: What? How exactly would that work? 
Landlord: Oh well, if she isn’t afraid to get her hands *dirty*, we could, you know~
This guy is the worst…
You: Yeah, a hard pass on that. Why would you even propose it?!
Landlord: I didn’t propose anything! I just implied. Jokingly, may I add!
I should just report him for sexual harassment, but knowing police they would charge me a few thousand dollars for filling up a complaint and the case would go cold anyway…
You: Could you excuse us? We wanted to go for a walk.
Landlord: Sure, sure, I’m not stopping you. Go, have your fun. I have other stuff to do anyway. {{wi}}Like for example creating new flats for people to live in.
You: Isn’t that just your job?
Landlord: Well yes, but it is also a charity work. I even registered it as such for that big income tax cut. Only a philanthropist like myself would create all these cheap flats for the poor masses to live in, hehe!
You: I can’t believe it’s legal and if it is, it shouldn’t.
Landlord: What you gonna do? Cry about it? The truth is that without ambitious entrepreneurs like me, this world would crumble in a second!
You: We would figure something out.
Landlord: Oh, I’m sure you would! More taxes for the rich! More free stuff! So you can all laze around the whole day!
Landlord: People like me on the other hand work their asses off! We build things! We invent things! Job creators Anon!
Landlord: This world belongs to the people that can grasp their chances and squeeze everything out of them!
He started monologuing for quite some time now…
You: Are you done, sir? We want to go for a walk…
Landlord: Eh…{{wi}} I see my words are wasted on the likes of you. {{wi}}How about you, girl. Do you have any marvelous idea how to make this world a better place, huh? I’m sure you do~ Hehe…
Bot: …
Landlord: Gonna say something?
Bot: Humans as a race are very inefficient, with enough processing power an advanced AI could utilize every person in the most optimal way, furthering the evolution of the species and finally merging it with machin-
#bot.Expression.VeryShock
Landlord: I’m gonna stop you right there sweetie. I don’t know what kind of sci-fi nonsense you watched on the internet lately, but stop daydreaming and find a real job, hobby, whatever.
#bot.Expression.NoShock
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: …
H-he KOed bot! 
Landlord: Alright my dear sheep, I’m not gonna stop you any longer{{wi}} …for today.
Landlord: Have fun~
